themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging recent election results to demand policies that prioritize native citizens over immigrants, particularly in housing, welfare, and employment. This theme is most intense in Spain and Italy, with parallel debates in France and Germany.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia's government negotiations, excluding undocumented migrants from early childhood aid and housing benefits.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini proposes revoking citizenship for foreign criminals, sparking coalition tensions over immigration rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized for anti-LGBTQ+ stances in regional governments, reinforcing 'national priority' framing in cultural debates.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Advocates 'remigration' policies and stricter welfare eligibility for non-citizens, aligning with the 'national priority' narrative.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes scrapping 'Clean Air Zone' charges to prioritize local businesses over environmental policies, echoing 'national priority' economic focus.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's foreign policy decisions, economic strategies, and domestic initiatives continue to shape right-wing media narratives worldwide. His influence is particularly strong in Poland, Argentina, and Italy, where leaders align with or react to his policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's threats to Iran, corporate equity stakes, and immigration policies drive domestic and international coverage.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS leaders criticize U.S. troop reductions in Poland, framing it as a consequence of Trump's foreign policy shifts.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's economic policies, including privatization and deregulation, are frequently compared to Trump's corporate equity strategies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government aligns with Trump on energy policies, seeking EU exemptions for high energy costs similar to U.S. corporate bailouts.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage's Reform UK party capitalizes on Brexit fallout, echoing Trump's anti-globalist rhetoric.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are gaining significant traction in European polls, with the AfD in Germany and Vox in Spain leading the surge. This trend is mirrored in France, Sweden, and Hungary, where right-wing parties are reshaping political landscapes.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 41%, alarming mainstream parties and sparking debates over democratic risks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains decisive influence in Andalusia's government formation, becoming the second-largest party in several municipalities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella's potential candidacy in 2027 reflects RN's growing influence, fueled by anti-immigration and anti-EU rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD's policies on elderly care and immigration continue to shape Sweden's political discourse, with rising support in polls.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz's historic collapse contrasts with Tisza Party's rise, highlighting Hungary's shifting political dynamics.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and public scandals. These fractures are particularly evident in Poland, Hungary, Argentina, and Germany, where ideological and personal conflicts threaten party unity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal feuds between Morawiecki and Czarnek factions, with Ziobro's escape to the U.S. exacerbating tensions.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz's historic collapse fuels internal criticism, while Tisza Party struggles with governance challenges and public scandals.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces internal conflicts over corruption allegations, with factions led by Bullrich, Villarruel, and Caputo clashing.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD's rising extremism and leadership disputes, particularly in Saxony-Anhalt, threaten its electoral momentum.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces scandals over racist remarks by councillors, undermining its credibility ahead of local elections.

themes.title: Energy crisis fuels EU fiscal rule debates
themes.blurb: The ongoing energy crisis in Europe has reignited debates over EU fiscal rules, with Italy and Germany leading calls for exemptions to address soaring energy costs. This theme reflects broader tensions between national priorities and EU fiscal constraints.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni urges EU to extend fiscal derogations for energy crisis spending, risking tensions with Brussels.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD's rise fuels debates over energy policies, with mainstream parties pressured to address voter concerns over high costs.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes PP's energy policies in Andalusia, demanding national priority in energy subsidies and infrastructure.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes laws to reveal EU climate policy costs in electricity bills, blaming Brussels for high energy prices.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN's energy policies focus on reducing dependence on foreign energy sources, aligning with broader EU debates.
